projects.name: ZulipGPT: LLM Integration for Chat Summarization in Open-Source Messaging
highlights: Shipped chat and inbox summarization into the Zulip open-source codebase with topic-drift detection and citation-backed prompts to reduce hallucination and injection risk.

Cut summarization latency to under 15s via trigger-based invocation, rolling context windows, and message batching.

research.name: PRISM: Probing Routed Information Flow via Structured Multimodal Bottlenecks
highlights: Designed & validated hierarchical fusion variant outperforming symmetric design by +2.7% (Acc2/F1); identified asymmetric (AV/VA) fusion matches symmetric performance with fewer parameters; a key insight for production multimodal model design.
Researched fusion efficiency in multimodal models; discovered that scaling fusion capacity (4 to 12 tokens) on CMU-MOSEI/MOSI hurts performance (-6% correlation), revealing architectural waste.

research.name: ScleraNext: Lightweight CNN Segmentation for Real-Time Biometric Identification

research.name: WorldVLM: Tuning Vision-Language Models as World Models for Web Agent Action Prediction
highlights: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL on Mind2Web trajectories to jointly predict the next action and resulting visual page state, an upgrade to the current SoTA which simulate next states via text description with no visual grounding.
Framed web browsing as a transition function over (state, action) pairs, enabling consequence-aware planning rather than reactive step-by-step execution.

research.name: GraphAct: Graph-Structured Action Prediction for Web Agents
highlights: Benchmarked 10 baselines on Multimodal Mind2Web using Qwen3-VL and InternVL2-8B; integrating hierarchical structure to HTML DOM for this task, which has been lacking in the current State-of-The-Art.

Adding a Graph Transformer Encoder over DOM graphs to a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, projecting node embeddings into the LLM token space, and training with composite loss to account for alignment, prediction and action history consistency.
